messages:
sam (New Hire): hey team — starting next Tue from the UK. quick Qs: when do benefits actually kick in if you start mid-month? i signed enrollment but wasn’t sure about NHS vs company private health — can i opt out? also i paid visa fees out of pocket, is there a reimbursement route? :thinking:
lena (People Ops): welcome Sam! :wave: For UK hires we default to offering Redwood PrivateHealth but you can opt out to remain on NHS-only. Benefit effective date is generally the first of the month after 30 days when you start mid-month — so for a 3/31 start that would be 5/1. For visa/immigration fees we reimburse work-related immigration costs case-by-case. please upload receipts to the HR portal and tag them "immigration" and we'll route to payroll for approval.
sam (New Hire): got it — so 5/1 makes sense. does pension auto-enrol immediately or after a probation period? and FYI my home office stipend isn't showing up in the payroll portal for first paycheck.
aditi (Benefits): hi Sam — pension auto-enrolment happens on the first payroll cycle after 3 months per gov regs and our policy. for the stipend, that's handled by payroll ops. can you DM payroll@redwood with your employee ID? i'll cc payroll here.
payroll-bot: payroll@redwood received a request. please include "employee-id" and "start-date" in the email subject. typical processing time is 1-2 pay cycles. if urgent, reply in this thread and we'll escalate.
sam (New Hire): uploaded immigration_voucher.pdf and visa_receipt.jpg to the HR portal and added a short note saying i want to opt out of private health (NHS only). do i need to sign a formal opt-out form?
lena (People Ops): thanks — i can see the uploads. yes, we require a signed waiver for private health opt-out; i'll DM you the waiver doc to e-sign. i've flagged payroll about the stipend and immigration reimbursement. @mike (Payroll) can you confirm expected timing once receipts approved?
mike (Payroll): on it. if receipts are uploaded before payroll cut-off this cycle (Fri 5pm BST) reimbursement will be processed in the following payroll (about 2 weeks). the home office stipend missed on first cycle should be added to next pay. if anything slips, ping me here with the payroll ticket number and i'll prioritize.
sam (New Hire): awesome — thanks everyone. one last Q: do I need to submit any cross-border tax form (like W-8BEN) as an employee, or is that only for contractors?
lena (People Ops): for employees in the UK we use PAYE payroll; no W-8BEN required (that’s for non-resident contractors). i'll DM you the UK onboarding tax checklist and confirm the opt-out waiver. welcome aboard! :party_parrot:
